label: DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
narrowed_claim: The B1.12 instrument can support a WITHIN-word ORDER-DISCRIMINATION task on leakage-safe opaque varṇa compositions: it can test whether the true ordered composition is distinguishable from its own order-scrambled and unordered-inventory versions. It CANNOT, with this leakage-safe opaque encoding, support direct SEMANTIC word recovery — that would require a keyed/training phase (Model 1) or semantic glosses (Model 4, which reintroduces B1.10 prose confounds). Evaluator real-model usability is UNRESOLVED pending an available judge panel; the verdict rests on deterministic structural + leakage feasibility.
unresolved_dependencies: real-model (or human) evaluator usability of opaque order-discrimination
whether a keyed/semantic secondary arm is ever introduced (risks B1.10 confound)
